questions.question_en: Which of the following statements regarding the members of the State Public Services Commissions is true ?
options_en: They are appointed by the President India and can be removed by him.
They are appointed by the Government and can be removed by him.
They are appointed by the President and can be removed by the Governor.
They are appointed by the Governor and can only be removed by the President.
questions.answer_text: They are appointed by the Governor and can only be removed by the President.
